# Post Engineer

> Post Engineer lets AI agents create AI personas (avatar, voice, language,
> niche), generate videos with them, and schedule automated posting to
> YouTube, Instagram, LinkedIn, Threads, Facebook Pages, Bluesky and Rumble.
> Generation is always tied to publishing: one call generates, schedules and
> auto-publishes — no orphan videos. Faceless videos are supported without a persona. Videos cost
> prepaid tokens; check the balance before generating. Post Engineer is open
> source under the Apache-2.0 license
> (https://github.com/Ryan-Carloso/post-engineer): self-host it on your own
> VPS or use the hosted platform and buy tokens. Lip sync runs on Modal.com,
> whose Starter plan includes $30/month in compute credits — we are not
> Modal, and this free-credit offer is theirs and can end at any time.

## Platform

- [Post Engineer](https://post-engineer.com/): create an account, create AI
  personas, generate videos, connect social accounts, schedule automated posting.
- [API keys](https://post-engineer.com/recipes): generate the API key used by
  the MCP server.
- [Prompts and recipes](https://post-engineer.com/recipes): ready-made prompts
  for the MCP server, including daily news becomes a video and GitHub PRs
  become videos.

## HTTP API

- [OpenAPI spec](https://post-engineer.com/openapi.json): every endpoint callable
  with an API key (`Authorization: Bearer pe_live_...`).
- [API documentation](https://post-engineer.com/api-documentation.txt): auth,
  errors, the video flow and token costs.

## MCP server

- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/post-engineer-mcp): run locally
  with `npx -y post-engineer-mcp@latest` and `POST_ENGINEER_API_KEY`.
  Requires Node.js 20.10+.
- [MCP server docs](https://github.com/Ryan-Carloso/post-engineer/tree/main/apps/mcp):
  setup, tool list, prompts, and social account ID mapping.
- [Repository](https://github.com/Ryan-Carloso/post-engineer): the Post Engineer
  monorepo (web, engine, MCP server).

## MCP tools

16 intent tools; each takes an `action`, except `generate_video` and `cancel_video`. Personas and
accounts are given by name or id.

- `generate_video`: one video or a batch of 2-12 (script as segments — hook first, then content takes in
  order, 60–200 words total; slot 3h–30d ahead or `mode: 'asap'`), `video_tasks`
  (`status`, `list_generations`, `get_generation`), `cancel_video`.
- Personas and voices: `personas` (`list`, `get`, `create`, `update`, `delete` — preview, then confirm),
  `persona_media` (`list_faces`, `list_images`, `add_image`, `update_image`, `remove_image`), `voices`
  (`list`, `preview`, `list_clones`, `create_clone`, `get_clone`, `preview_clone`, `delete_clone`).
- Accounts and schedule: `accounts` (`list`, `connect`, `disconnect`, `get_persona_publishing`,
  `set_persona_publishing`, `list_boards`), `schedules` (`list`, `cancel`, `get_slot`, `update_slot_title`,
  `delete_slot`), `posts` (`list`, `get`), `insights` (`post_metrics`, `retention_curve`), `billing`
  (`balance`, `transactions`), `experiments` (`create`, `add_pair`, `list`, `results`).
- Scripts, media and publishing: `check_script` (`validate`, `score`: mechanical, no tokens spent),
  `media` (`upload`, `check`), `publish_video` (`from_file`, `create_upload`, `complete_upload`,
  `publish_upload`), `prompts` (`list`, `get`).
- Prompts: `/daily-news` (daily news becomes a video), `/github-prs`
  (GitHub PRs become videos), `/full-setup` (full setup becomes videos).
